browser_walkthrough.reason: The live reading surface already fails the event/context content checks below; a live browser walkthrough would only re-observe the same missing event spans and context entities. Offline fixture browser/interaction evidence remains T16's `reading-flow-smoke.mjs --suite all`.

content_findings: Real joint chapter generation failed closed repeatedly on reading contract rules: `inherit` mode units carried `current_event_refs`, and anchor occurrence/block mismatches; the 三國志 job needed 4 job attempts and chunk 1 needed 3 runs.

Published 三國志 units expose 27 narrative_time event refs but zero event word segments (`segments[].kind == 'event'`) and zero `context_entities`, so the body event-word entry and the current people/place panel have no data.
Published 資治通鑑 units are all `narrative_time.mode == 'unknown'` (0 events, 1 group), including the explicit 建安十一年/十二年/十三年 year headers; the narrative-time axis is therefore empty for that work.

narrative_time event refs are source-local (`evt_000001`); the public event preview/targets route requires canonical UUID ids and there are no event-span targets, so event back-navigation cannot be exercised from the published stream.
unverified: Independent human/strong-reviewer confirmation of the real content is pending.
Live desktop/keyboard/touch/narrow reading walkthrough and event-preview return to the original unit were not run because the published content lacks event spans and context entities.
Real provider token usage/cost is not captured by the gate; only call timings are observable (see per-job stage timestamps).

generation_limits.job_max_attempts_scope: bounds failing retries in control_plane.retry_job; resume after needs_review is a separate claim
generation_limits.chapter_max_correction_rounds_scope: T03 chapter_contract.ChapterLimits.max_correction_rounds is fixed at 1, so one chunk run makes at most 2 model attempts (initial + 1 correction) before failing closed

ownership_handoffs.owned_failure: Full-chapter 0.2 generation and reading-annotation output: `inherit` units carrying `current_event_refs`, anchor occurrence/block mismatches, repeated fail-closed runs (chunk needed 3 job claims), and missing event spans/context in the accepted reading units.

narrative-time grouping and local-to-canonical event remapping: all year_key values unresolved (unknown/mixed:unknown), no year groups, and source-local event refs not remapped to canonical public ids.
persisted reading stream segments/context/event membership: published units carry no event spans and no context_entities.
locate/pagination re-verification once valid time/event indexes exist.
event preview/targets contract across source-local vs canonical event ids and canonical back-navigation.
active-unit context verification (context_entities empty at the source of the reading unit).
